name: GB energy supply margins
value: No notice in force; 5.9 GW winter margin
summary: No Electricity Margin Notice or Gas Margins Notice found in force on 19 Nov; winter outlooks show adequate buffers
state: NESO's winter outlook forecasts a 5.9 GW de-rated margin, about a 9.5% buffer over peak demand, and notes that Electricity Margin Notices occur in most winters (NESO). National Gas expects sufficient supply with a 99 mcm/d buffer over a 493 mcm/d peak (Pipeline & Gas Journal). Searches on 19 Nov found no Electricity Margin Notice, capacity market notice or Gas Margins Notice in force, so the signal stays Normal.
for_you: Britain's power and gas systems are expected to cope this winter. A margin notice, if issued, is a routine call for extra supply and does not by itself mean power cuts.
rubric_hit: Normal: no NESO or National Gas notice issued as of 19 Nov; forecast margin 5.9 GW

sources.title: Pipeline & Gas Journal — UK gas grid ready for winter with 99 mcm/d supply buffer

why: When gas or electricity margins tighten, Britain risks price spikes and, at worst, controlled disconnections in winter.
drivers: Gas imports and storage, wind output, interconnectors, plant outages, cold weather.

rubric.alert: A Gas Deficit Warning, a high risk of demand control notice, or demand control used.
rubric.watch: NESO issues an Electricity Margin Notice or capacity market notice, or National Gas issues a Gas Margins Notice.
rubric.normal: NESO and National Gas report adequate margins; no notices issued.
